name: FracFocus

agency.name: FracFocus Chemical Disclosure Registry (Ground Water Protection Council and Interstate Oil and Gas Compact Commission)

form.name: Hydraulic fracturing chemical disclosure (filed by the operator or its agent through the FracFocus website; not a permit)
form.notes: Read through the registry's own data dictionary (the readme inside the download, last updated November 2023) and the real column headers of all three kinds of file, checked on 2026-11-01. Operators file through the FracFocus website behind a login; the filing form itself was not opened. Versions: 1.0 (January 2011 to May 2013) holds header data only, 2.0 to 4.0 add the chemicals, and 4.0 (December 2023) adds optional water sources.

api_number.n: APINumber in every file, 14 digits as xx-xxx-xxxxx-00-00; the first ten digits are the well

permit_number.n: No permit or application number in any file; a disclosure has its own key, DisclosureId

well_name.n: WellName, as the filer typed it

lease_name.n: No lease, unit or property column

operator_name.n: OperatorName: the organization that filed, the operator or its agent (a person in some cases)

operator_id.n: No operator number: the name is the only identifier

bond.n: No bond or financial assurance column

county.n: CountyName, worked out from the API number

field_pool.n: No field, pool or play column

surface_latlon.n: Latitude, Longitude and the datum (Projection: NAD27, NAD83 or WGS84)

surface_plss.n: No section, township, range or footages

bottom_hole_loc.n: One point per disclosure, the surface location; no bottom-hole point

elevation.n: No elevation column (TVD is measured from the kelly bushing, whose height is not given)

surface_owner.n: No surface owner or surface use column

well_type.n: Oil or gas is not told apart; wells that are not oil or gas are a separate download

work_type.n: No type of work: new drill, re-entry or recompletion is not said

well_direction.n: No vertical, directional or horizontal flag

proposed_depth_md.n: True vertical depth only; no measured depth

proposed_depth_tvd.n: TVD, usually the current or final depth as filed; not a planned depth

pressure_control.n: No blowout preventer or pressure control column

water.n: Gallons of water and of other base fluid; each water source and its share (optional since Dec 2023)

fracture_plan.n: A disclosure records the job as done, never a plan; the four fracturing rows below say what it holds

frac_dates.n: JobStartDate and JobEndDate: the fracturing job's own start and end days

frac_chemicals.n: CASNumber, IngredientName and IngredientCommonName for every ingredient of every additive

frac_additives.n: TradeName, Supplier and Purpose of every additive

frac_amounts.n: PercentHFJob and PercentHighAdditive (percent) and MassIngredient (pounds) for each ingredient

spacing_unit.n: No spacing unit, acreage or pooling column

mineral_owner.n: Only a yes or no for federal and for tribal land or minerals (FederalWell, IndianWell); no owner

notice_hearing.n: No notice, hearing or protest column

date_received.n: No filing date in the download; the two job dates are its only dates

date_approved.n: A disclosure is not approved by an agency; no approval or issue date

spud_date.n: JobStartDate is the start of the fracturing job, not the spud date

completion_date.n: JobEndDate is the end of the fracturing job, not the date the well was completed

form_image.n: The disclosure PDF, named on the data download page; the Find a Well search is one well at a time

sources.name: FracFocus data download: FracFocusRegistry_N.csv, a row for every ingredient of every disclosure (15 files in one 443 MB zip)
sources.license: Terms of use accepted on the download page: the data may be combined with other data but not altered

sources.name: FracFocus data download: DisclosureList_N.csv, one row for each disclosure (the well, the job, the water; no chemicals)
sources.license: Terms of use accepted on the download page: the data may be combined with other data but not altered

sources.name: FracFocus data download: WaterSource_N.csv, one row for each water source of a disclosure
sources.license: Terms of use accepted on the download page: the data may be combined with other data but not altered

sources.name: Find a Well (Find O&G Disclosures): the registry's search, with the disclosure PDF of a well

grade_reason: Bulk, free and open, with every fractured well in the country in one download: its point, county, the job's start and end days, depth, water and every chemical. It holds no permit and no approval date, so it cannot count permits: it records the fracturing job, filed after it, not the permit. The download page says the data are as the operator filed them and that corrections are approved by the state agencies that require a disclosure.
producer_plan: Already built. The Overview's map and the Daily report read the disclosure list by range requests (d13_newwells.py, data/newwells/), and build_db.py --fracfocus loads the whole registry with its water sources into the local database; the ingredients are only in the local database (about 2.5 GB). A disclosure comes weeks to months after the permit, so it is shown beside the permit counts and never added into them.
privacy_notes: The registry names API numbers and well names, and some operators are people. The site publishes none of those from it: the map holds a well's point, county, day, depth and water, and an operator only when it is a corporation, LLC or limited partnership. The local database snapshot holds the registry as filed (README, Privacy).
unknowns: Whether every disclosure has a PDF online: the download page names the disclosure PDF files, but the Find a Well page needs JavaScript and was not opened
Whether the terms of use are a license: they say the data may be combined but not altered, and no open license is named
Which states require a disclosure and how soon after the job: the rules differ by state and none is in the files
Wells that are not oil and gas wells are a separate download, which was not read

registry_fields.label: Disclosure ID
registry_fields.plain: The key for one disclosure; every file links back to it.

registry_fields.label: API number
registry_fields.plain: The well's API number, written xx-xxx-xxxxx-00-00: state, county, well.

registry_fields.label: State
registry_fields.plain: The state of the well's surface location, worked out from the API number.

registry_fields.label: County
registry_fields.plain: The county of the well's surface location, worked out from the API number.

registry_fields.label: Operator
registry_fields.plain: The organization that filed the disclosure: the operator or its agent.

registry_fields.label: Well name
registry_fields.plain: The name of the well, as filed.

registry_fields.label: On federal land or minerals
registry_fields.plain: Yes or no: the well is on federal land or minerals.

registry_fields.label: On tribal land or minerals
registry_fields.plain: Yes or no: the well is on tribal land or minerals.

registry_fields.label: FracFocus version
registry_fields.plain: Which version of the FracFocus form the filer used, 1.0 to 4.0.

registry_fields.label: Latitude
registry_fields.plain: Decimal degrees of the well's location, as filed.

registry_fields.label: Longitude
registry_fields.plain: Decimal degrees of the well's location, as filed; west is negative.

registry_fields.label: Datum
registry_fields.plain: The coordinate system of the point: NAD27, NAD83 or WGS84.

registry_fields.label: Job start
registry_fields.plain: The day the fracturing job started, not counting site preparation. It is not the spud date.

registry_fields.label: Job end
registry_fields.plain: The day the fracturing job was completed, not counting teardown. It is not the well's completion date.

registry_fields.label: True vertical depth
registry_fields.plain: The vertical distance from the surface to a point in the well, usually the current or final depth.

registry_fields.label: Water used
registry_fields.plain: Gallons of water used as the carrier fluid of the job.

registry_fields.label: Other base fluid
registry_fields.plain: Gallons of carrier fluid that is not water.

registry_fields.label: Water source ID
registry_fields.plain: The key for one water source of a disclosure. Water sources are optional since December 2023.

registry_fields.label: Water source
registry_fields.plain: What kind of water was used, such as surface water, produced water or recycled water.

registry_fields.label: Share of the water
registry_fields.plain: The percent of the job's water that came from that source.

registry_fields.label: Additive ID
registry_fields.plain: The key for one additive of a disclosure.

registry_fields.label: Trade name
registry_fields.plain: The name of the product, as its supplier gives it.

registry_fields.label: Supplier
registry_fields.plain: The company that supplied the product, usually the service company.

registry_fields.label: Purpose
registry_fields.plain: Why the product was used: a surfactant, a biocide, a proppant and so on.

registry_fields.label: Ingredient ID
registry_fields.plain: The key for one ingredient of an additive.

registry_fields.label: CAS number
registry_fields.plain: The Chemical Abstracts Service number that identifies the chemical.

registry_fields.label: Chemical name
registry_fields.plain: The name of the chemical or, for a trade secret, its chemical family.

registry_fields.label: Common name
registry_fields.plain: A common name for the chemical, chosen by how often it is filed.

registry_fields.label: Share of the product
registry_fields.plain: The most of the ingredient in the product, in percent, from the product's safety data sheet.

registry_fields.label: Share of the job
registry_fields.plain: The ingredient's share of the whole fracturing fluid, in percent by mass.

registry_fields.label: Comment
registry_fields.plain: Any note the filer made about the ingredient.

registry_fields.label: On a safety data sheet
registry_fields.plain: Yes or no: the ingredient is listed on the product's safety data sheet.

registry_fields.label: Mass used
registry_fields.plain: Pounds of the ingredient used on the job.

registry_fields.label: Trade-secret claimant
registry_fields.plain: The company claiming a trade secret on the ingredient.
